This dysregulation can manifest as nephrolithiasis (MONDO:0013247), and in infantile forms, contribute to hypercalcemia (MONDO:0014851) and rickets.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in SLC34A1 that are exclusively associated with one disease and not the other, or the demonstration of distinct molecular mechanisms for each disease despite the shared gene, would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: Presence of common benign variants in SLC34A1 in gnomAD that are implicated in either disease.)_
